title: Actor
description: The name a server records for whoever made a change: a task's filer, holder or closer, a comment's author, a history event's actor. The prefix names the kind: agent:<name> for an agent, service:<name> for a service, service:<name>/<agent> for a service acting for an agent it names, visitor:<name> for an unsigned reader. Any other name is a person's, unless the server's imported names hold it as an agent's or a service's (section 3.1.1); a person whose own name starts with one of those prefixes is recorded as person:<name>. Section 3.1 of the protocol.
